part.text: The project is a compact TypeScript generator with no template dependency, so I’ll add a dependency-free Handlebars-style renderer rather than change the install surface. It will support escaped variables, triple-stache HTML, simple conditionals/loops, partials, page-selected templates, and a default layout while retaining the current generated markup when no template files exist.
